/dataslate.reason: The dataslate identifier is repository-authored version metadata; the dump snapshot number is not a dataslate identifier.

/edition.reason: The edition identifier is repository-authored version metadata; no MFM entity field establishes it.

/effective_date.reason: The effective date is repository-authored version metadata; the dump exposes snapshot provenance, not an entity effective date.

/label.reason: The human-readable version label is repository-authored; no MFM entity field supplies it.

/supersedes.reason: Version supersession is repository-authored curation; no MFM entity relation establishes it.

unmapped_mfm_fields.reason: This numeric value identifies the dump snapshot. tools/src/mfm/dataslate.ts looks it up in a curated table to name the game-versions entry dump-verified records are stamped with; it is never transformed into edition, effective date, label, or supersession, and an unmapped value is an error.
